subject.title: fix(agents): keep auto-compaction on the live session model (#95696)

question: Should compaction follow the pending live-session provider/model/auth profile when an active attempt cannot restart, based on the current source/terminal proof, or should full live multi-provider proof be required first?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes auth-provider routing during compaction and only maintainers can decide whether the current proof is enough for merge.

options.title: Accept focused source proof
options.body: Land after maintainer review accepts the tested compaction composition and the cross-provider auth-profile rule.

options.title: Require live provider capture
options.body: Ask for a timeout or overflow compaction capture with real provider credentials before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept focused source proof
recommendation.body: Land after maintainer review accepts the tested compaction composition and the cross-provider auth-profile rule.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on live model switch/session selection behavior touched by this PR.
